component.name: pbs-zabbix
component.summary: Zabbix monitoring for Proxmox Backup Server

description.p: pbs-zabbix monitors Proxmox Backup Server (PBS) datastores and alerts when a scheduled backup did not complete successfully.

Using Zabbix low-level discovery, it enumerates every VM/CT that has ever been backed up by reading directly from /var/log/proxmox-backup/tasks, without calling the PBS API and without requiring root privileges. For each discovered VM/CT it exposes the age of the last successful backup and the last recorded task status, so a Zabbix trigger can notify you as soon as a backup job fails or simply never ran.
